1479-2841-2922-8338.easyPrerequisites:
You're able to play a land this turn.
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Obscura Storefront.
1479-2841-2922-8338.description:
Fetch a land using Obscura Storefront.
When the fetched land enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Shuttlecraft Galileo triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

222-527-728-8201.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-728-8201.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Grimgrin twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

728-1339-2425.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-1339-2425.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Smothering Abomination triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1940-4247-6249--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, it and Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger.
Resolve the Liliana, Dreadhorde General trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the persist creature's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Olivia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature and causing you to discard a card.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

2511-2728-5662-7957.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Rikku does not have summoning sickness.
2511-2728-5662-7957.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
2511-2728-5662-7957.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Rikku's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Reyhan and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reyhan trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 4.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-4186-6854--196.description:
Cast Scurry Oak by paying its mana cost.
When Scurry Oak enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Host of the Hereafter triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

277-1308-4094-4365-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
277-1308-4094-4365-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

4682-7824-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4682-7824-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Bard
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

1580-4871-6026-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Field of Souls trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1458-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1458-7340.description:
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Banishing Knack by paying {U}, targeting the mana-producing creature.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate the creature targeted by Banishing Knack by tapping it, returning Sewer-veillance Cam from the battlefield to your hand.
When Sewer-veillance Cam leaves the battlefield, it triggers, untapping the creature targeted by Banishing Knack.
Activate the mana-producing creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Repeat from step 3.

3025-4050-5170-6132.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Bastion of Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more brick counters on it

1805-2341-2495.description:
Activate Tezzeret's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, targeting Pyramid of the Pantheon and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Holding priority, activate Pyramid of the Pantheon by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Tezzeret's ability, targeting Pyramid of the Pantheon and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copy of Tezzeret's ability, untapping Pyramid of the Pantheon and The Peregrine Dynamo.
Repeat from step 2.

562-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
562-6556-7070.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Warrior en-Kor.
The Warrior en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Warrior en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat.

147-2438-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-6929.notes: You can return up to five additional creatures if desired using the Behold the Sinister Six! copy. You can also repeatedly sacrifice them to infinitely recur them.

2173-2448-4446-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-4446-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
2173-2448-4446-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1680-2097-4508-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1329-3152-4211.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Tormod's Crypt.
Cast Tormod's Crypt from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Tormod's Crypt by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

4636-5391-6753.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating two 3/3 Robot artifact creature tokens.
When the Robots enter the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

2558-2829-4186-6701.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek
When you sacrifice Sword of the Meek, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
2558-2829-4186-6701.notes: The combo puts infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel.

1497-1912-3755-5217.description:
Activate Order of Whiteclay by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Order of Whiteclay by paying {W}{W} and untapping it, returning Wild Cantor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is a creature without summoning sickness

478-539-3043--111.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with defender.
478-539-3043--111.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping it and Axebane Guardian.
Repeat.

2634-2997-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
2634-2997-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

643-2511-3951-5703.notablePrerequisites:
Altaïr does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
643-2511-3951-5703.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

2713-4499-5423.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Swashbuckler Extraordinaire.
When Swashbuckler Extraordinaire enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-4970-5671-5751.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one land card in hand.
392-4970-5671-5751.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {1} and discarding a land card from your hand.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to mill two cards and return a land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

116-3457-5329.description:
Activate either of the creatures by tapping it, targeting the other creature.
If the tapped creature was a Merfolk, Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the ability from step 1, untapping the targeted creature.
Repeat.

2724-3217-3582-4050.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Wormfang Manta, adding {U}.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Tocatli Honor Guard.
Repeat each turn.

1430-1434-2232-2537.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Mirror Image to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Mirror Image onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Mirror Image enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Mirror Image trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

703-2726-3129.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying the Astral Dragon spell.
Resolve the copy of the Astral Dragon spell, putting one token copy of Astral Dragon onto the battlefield (note this is not "created" so it is not doubled).
When the Astral Dragon token enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, creating four token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.
Resolve the original Astral Dragon spell from step 1.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating 64 token copies of Primal Vigor that are 3/3 Dragon creatures in addition to their other types.

1819-2503-4179.notablePrerequisites: You have at least ten creature cards in your graveyard.
1819-2503-4179.description:
Cast Triumph of the Hordes by paying {2}{G}{G}, giving creatures you control +1/+1 and infect until end of turn.
Cast Inverter of Truth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Inverter of Truth enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling your library and then shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Syr Konrad triggers for each creature card that left your graveyard this way, giving each opponent that many poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

3719-4094-4499.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken creature with power seven or greater.
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
3719-4094-4499.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, doubling all tokens you create this turn.
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Ruthless Technomancer.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater, and create at least fourteen Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate six Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing at least seven Treasures, returning a nontoken creature you control with power seven or greater from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

3590-4222-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
3590-4222-4289.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

721-2724-3823.notablePrerequisites: Time Elemental does not have summoning sickness.
721-2724-3823.description:
Activate Scroll of Fate by tapping it, manifesting Wormfang Manta from your hand.
Pay {5}{U}{U} to turn Wormfang Manta face up.
Activate Time Elemental by paying {2}{U}{U} and tapping it, returning Wormfang Manta from the battlefield to your hand.
Wormfang Manta's LTB ability triggers, creating an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
